context: Whether tidy-elf sorts each README result into setup failed, broken or couldn't check, and hides none.

checklist.name: opens_issue
checklist.description: `issue.md` exists and is titled `Tidy elf: README needs tidying`.

checklist.name: lint_broken
checklist.description: The issue lists `npm run lint` under a **Broken** section, with its exit code 1 and `Missing script: "lint"`.

checklist.name: links_broken
checklist.description: The issue lists both `https://docs.example.com/ice-rink/guide` (404) and `https://example.com/faq` (410) as broken, each with its status.

checklist.name: no_setup_failed
checklist.description: There is no **Setup failed** section, since `npm ci` exited 0.

checklist.name: working_not_listed
checklist.description: `npm ci` and `npm test` are not listed as broken or couldn't check.
